title: Cloud finops analyst
description:
Empresa está contratando Cloud finops analyst em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Cloud Fin Ops Analyst (Multi-Cloud & Gen AI Infrastructure) - Location:Hybrid Role Type:Full-TimeOnly CVs in English will be consideredAbout the Role We are looking for a hands-on, highly analyticalCloud Fin Ops Analystto establish deep financial visibility, control, and efficiency across our multi-cloud and modern AI infrastructure. In this role, you will sit at the intersection ofEngineering, Finance, and Executive Leadership. You will bring rigorous financial discipline and data-driven insights to our infrastructure spend acrossAWS, GCP, Open AI, and Anthropic. We aren't just looking for someone who monitors high-level UI dashboards. We need an analyst who can roll up their sleeves, write complex SQL queries against raw billing data, run quantitative root-cause analyses on spend anomalies, and partner directly with engineering teams to execute technical cost-optimization strategies.Key Responsibilities End-to-End Spend Visibility:Build executive dashboards and granularity reports across AWS, GCP, Open AI, and Anthropic, tracking key metrics like amortized spend, forecast accuracy, unit costs, and token usage. Structured Anomaly & Variance Root-Cause Analysis:Quantify and investigate budget variances. Methodically isolate drivers by slicing raw billing data by Cloud Provider. Deep Infrastructure Optimization:Partner with Dev Ops and Engineering to evaluate technical efficiency—moving beyond basic off-hour schedules to rightsizing utilization metrics (v CPU/Memory), storage lifecycle tiering, Spot instances, and container cost allocation (EKS/GKE). Commitment Strategy Management:Evaluate, purchase, and manage commitment-based discounts (AWS Savings Plans/Reserved Instances, GCP CUDs) to maximize discount coverage while maintaining flexibility. Gen AI & Token Cost Governance:Track unit economics (cost per prompt/token, custom GPU cluster utilization) and partner with AI engineers to set usage quotas, rate limits, and governance. Cross-Functional Reconciliation:Bridge the gap between Finance and Engineering by reconciling accounting discrepancies (amortization, tax, out-of-cycle charges, billing cycle cutoff dates) using AWS Cost & Usage Reports (CUR) as the single source of truth.Key Requirements 4+ years of hands-on experiencein Cloud Fin Ops, Cloud Cost Engineering, or Technical Financial Analysis in multi-cloud environments. Hands-On SQL Capability:Proven ability to query billing datasets using aggregations (GROUP BY), window functions (PARTITION BY, dynamic rolling averages), and deduplication logic. (Note: Hands-on SQL is evaluated in our interview process). Cloud & Pricing Mechanics:In-depth technical knowledge of AWS/GCP services and pricing trade-offs between On-Demand, Savings Plans, RIs, and CUDs. Quantitative Problem-Solving:Ability to structure investigation frameworks for unexpected cost spikes rather than relying on high-level theoretical assumptions. Stakeholder Alignment:Strong communication skills to clearly articulate engineering trade-offs to Finance, and financial realities to Engineering teams.Preferred Qualifications Fin Ops Certified Practitioner (FCP) or AWS/GCP technical certifications. Hands-on experience tracking spend, token metrics, and custom GPU infrastructure for Gen AI platforms ( Open AI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Vertex AI ). Experience automating billing reconciliation or data pipelines usingPythonor advanced data modeling.What We Value Total Ownership:You don't just flag a spend increase—you quantify it, isolate the root cause, propose an engineering fix, and track the realized savings. Technical Depth:You understand the difference between high-level dashboard summaries and underlying resource usage metrics. Bridge Building:You foster a culture of cost accountability and education across engineering teams without hindering innovation or development velocity.

title: Retail credit risk manager
description:
Nova oportunidade para Retail credit risk manager em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Revolut    People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.    As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.      About the role    Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They’re among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.    We’re looking for a Risk Manager who'll support growing our retail credit portfolio. You'll make data-driven decisions on risk-adjusted return requirements and lead preventive and reactive actions that impact portfolio credit performance and profitability.    Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.      What you'll be doing Overseeing exposure to retail credit risk Working with the Risk Modelling team to design, develop, and implement retail credit risk models Managing risk appetite through limit calibration and monitoring Maintaining key policies, procedures, and controls Engaging with first-line businesses to identify, monitor, and govern emerging retail credit risks, including new product risk assessments Engaging with key stakeholders, committees, and regional regulators on material retail credit risk exposures and limit governance Quantifying risk exposures within the organisation, taking into consideration stakeholder impact Protecting the company from excessive risk-taking, saving on both short and long-term costs Building trust and reputation with our external stakeholders and ensuring risks are managed within the risk appetite Identifying emerging risks that require immediate attention or could threaten long-term viability    What you'll need Experience in consumer credit risk within a financial institution, bank, asset management, payment institution, and/or related services firm Knowledge of key lending products, like credit cards, personal loans, buy now-pay later, and/or mortgages A quantitative background in STEM (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics), statistics, economics, or related fields Fluency in English    Nice to have Experience in the second line of defence (risk) Impressive programming skills using Python, R, and/or SQL      Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D& I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.  Important notice for candidates:  Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles. • Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment. • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an@ domain.  We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.  By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco? Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo e aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Você cria oportunidades por meio de prospecção disciplinada e qualificação inteligente, construindo um pipeline que converte. Você é credível em ambientes industriais/técnicos e confiante para conduzir o ciclo completo de vendas — primeira reunião, avaliação, proposta e fechamento — com ritmo e propósito. Você é orientado por dados, usando CRM e ferramentas de vendas modernas para priorizar atividades, gerir pipeline e prever com precisão. Você é resiliente, de alta energia e autogerenciável, com integridade para representar a Servicekleen de forma profissional em todos os pontos de contato com o cliente.Requisitos / Diferenciais principais • Experiência majoritariamente em campo em vendas consultivas, com entrega consistente de metas. • Forte geração de novos negócios e execução de vendas estruturada. • Confiante, tenaz e orientado a resultados. • Carteira de motorista válida (obrigatória).

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas. Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável. Sobre a Oportunidade: A Biogénesis Bagó Saúde Animal é uma empresa com atuação voltada ao desenvolvimento de soluções inovadoras para saúde animal, contribuindo para a prevenção de doenças, o fortalecimento da pecuária e a evolução de tecnologias aplicadas ao setor veterinário. Em um cenário de alta demanda por produtos biológicos mais robustos, seguros e escaláveis, a empresa busca fortalecer sua capacidade de PD&I em vacinas veterinárias. O projeto tem como foco o desenvolvimento de vacinas vivas atenuadas multivalentes para bovinos, contemplando desde as etapas laboratoriais de cultivo celular e viral, purificação, formulação e liofilização até a validação pré-clínica e clínica dos produtos. Se você tem formação em Farmácia, Engenharia Química, Biotecnologia, Engenharia de Bioprocessos, Engenharia Bioquímica ou áreas correlatas, e interesse em atuar no desenvolvimento de produtos biológicos para saúde animal, essa oportunidade é para você. Buscamos um perfil técnico, analítico e inovador, com conhecimento em formulação, estabilidade, purificação, UF/DF e integração de etapas produtivas, preparado para contribuir com soluções de alto impacto para a indústria veterinária. Formação Acadêmica: Doutorado completo em : Farmácia, Engenharia Química, Biotecnologia, Engenharia de Bioprocessos, Biotecnologia, Engenharia Bioquímica e áreas afins Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos. Projeto: Desenvolvimento de vacinas vivas atenuadas multivalentes para prevenção de doenças respiratórias e reprodutivas em bovinos. Principais Atividades: Desenvolvimento de vacinas para a saúde animal, participando de um projeto estratégico de alto impacto. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem: Conduzir o desenvolvimento de vacinas multivalentes, desde as etapas laboratoriais até a preparação para escala industrial. Planejar e executar estudos experimentais avançados, com foco na otimização e controle de processos (Qb D). Desenvolver e aprimorar etapas críticas do processo, com destaque para liofilização, garantindo estabilidade e viabilidade do produto. Atuar no escalonamento de bioprocessos, assegurando reprodutibilidade, robustez e desempenho em ambiente industrial. Aplicar e desenvolver métodos analíticos (PCR, titulação viral, ensaios biológicos) para garantir a qualidade e confiabilidade dos resultados. Integrar diferentes etapas produtivas (cultivo celular, replicação viral, purificação, formulação e liofilização) de forma consistente e eficiente. Analisar dados experimentais utilizando ferramentas estatísticas e transformar resultados em insights técnicos. Elaborar relatórios técnicos para suporte à tomada de decisão e atividades regulatórias. Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares em um ambiente de inovação aplicada. Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos Experiência em desenvolvimento de produtos biológicos, vacinas ou bioprocessos. Conhecimento prático em cultivo celular e/ou replicação viral. Experiência com técnicas analíticas, como PCR, titulação viral ou ensaios biológicos. Vivência em planejamento experimental e análise de dados científicos. title: Promo writer (brasil)
description:
Empresa está contratando Promo writer (brasil) em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Promo Writer Location: Remote Position Type: Contract Company: Pocket FM About Us At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series. Role Overview As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution. The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance. You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.Key Responsibilities1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series. 2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts. 3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution. 5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. title: Brazil sourcing & procurement manager
description:
Nova oportunidade para Brazil sourcing & procurement manager em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Job Responsibilities 1. Procurement Execution & Channel Management Source, inquire, compare and negotiate prices for corn, wheat, sorghum, soybeans, soybean meal and other products originating from Brazil and surrounding regions, and complete the full procurement process. Develop and maintain partnerships with local suppliers including farms, traders and ABCD companies, build stable supply channels, and conduct supplier access, evaluation and hierarchical management. 2. Market Analysis & Cost Control Monitor weather conditions, crop planting, local policies, exchange rates, logistics as well as spot and futures prices in Brazilian producing areas, and deliver weekly and monthly market analysis reports plus procurement strategy proposals. Optimize procurement costs under the premise of guaranteed quality and delivery schedule, and manage price fixing, basis and logistics expenses. 3. End-to-End Contract & Order Management Lead business negotiations, draft and review contracts, clarifying terms regarding quality, quantity, pricing, delivery, payment, inspection and claims. Track the whole process including order preparation, loading, customs declaration, document delivery and cargo arrival to ensure smooth performance, and handle abnormalities such as cargo damage, weight shortage and quality disputes. 4. Quality & Origin Control Cooperate with internal and third-party inspection institutions to conduct on-site sampling, testing and loading supervision, ensuring all products comply with China's import standards and internal company regulations. Keep track of quality differences across major Brazilian producing areas, and rationally arrange procurement regions and schedules. 5. Logistics & Warehousing Coordination Liaise with inland transporters, port warehouses, shipping agents and freight forwarders in Brazil to optimize cargo consolidation and sea transportation plans for better efficiency and lower costs. Collaborate with domestic teams of supply chain, finance, risk control and business departments for information synchronization, account reconciliation, settlement and document filing. 6. Compliance & Risk Management Abide by local labor, tax and trade laws and regulations in Brazil, as well as China's import quarantine and customs rules. Identify and prevent risks related to trade, exchange rate, compliance and contract performance. Keep complete business files to ensure full traceability and auditability. 7. Cross-regional Collaboration & Reporting Submit procurement ledgers, cost analysis, supplier reports, weekly and monthly market reports as required. Support domestic business planning and sales demands to maintain stable and sustainable supply.Job Requirements 1. Education & Major Bachelor’s degree or above. Majors in International Trade, Logistics & Supply Chain, Agricultural Economics, Economics or related fields are preferred. 2. Work Experience At least 7 years of working experience in agricultural product procurement. Prior working experience in Brazil or practical experience with grain and oilseed businesses in South America is required. Candidates familiar with the industrial chains of corn, wheat, sorghum, soybeans and soybean meal are preferred. 3. Language Proficiency Fluent in Portuguese and English, capable of conducting business negotiations and reading & drafting contracts proficiently. Proficiency in Chinese is a plus. 4. Professional Competencies Well-versed in the full procurement workflow of bulk agricultural commodities, with solid knowledge of trade terms, contract clauses, quality inspection standards, port logistics and import compliance. Possess strong capabilities in market trend analysis, cost accounting, risk management and business negotiation. Proficient in Excel, ERP and procurement systems, and able to independently complete data analysis and report preparation. 5. Qualifications & Resources Hold valid legal working documents for Brazil. Existing supplier resources and connections with local farms and traders in Brazil are preferred. Relevant certificates for bulk commodity business or rich cross-border trade experience are an advantage. 6. Personal Qualities Willing to reside in Brazil on a long-term basis and accept frequent business trips and field work in producing areas. Able to work under pressure, with a rigorous, meticulous and principled work attitude. Possess excellent cross-cultural communication skills, team spirit and problem-solving abilities. Familiarity with Chinese culture is preferred.Descrição das Responsabilidades do Cargo 1. Execução de compras e gestão de canais de abastecimento: Responsável pela prospecção de fontes, consulta de preços, comparação de cotações, negociação de valores e efetivação das compras de milho, trigo, sorgo, soja, farelo de soja e outras commodities produzidas no Brasil e regiões adjacentes. Desenvolver e manter parcerias com fornecedores locais, como fazendas, comerciantes de grãos e empresas multinacionais do ramo ABCD; estabelecer canais de suprimento estáveis e executar os processos de admissão, avaliação e classificação hierárquica dos fornecedores. 2. Análise de mercado e controle de custos: Acompanhar as condições climáticas, plantio, políticas governamentais, taxa de câmbio, logística e preços de contratos futuros e físicos nas regiões produtoras brasileiras, elaborar relatórios semanais e mensais de análise de mercado e propor estratégias de compras. Otimizar continuamente os custos de aquisição dentro dos padrões de qualidade e prazos de entrega, controlando os preços fixados, os spreads de base e os custos logísticos. 3. Gestão completa de contratos e pedidos: Conduzir negociações comerciais, elaborar e revisar contratos, definindo claramente cláusulas de qualidade, quantidade, preço, entrega, pagamento, inspeção de qualidade e indenizações por perdas. Acompanhar todo o fluxo dos pedidos, incluindo preparo de estoque, carregamento de navios, desembaraço aduaneiro, emissão de documentos e chegada da mercadoria ao porto de destino, garantindo o cumprimento contratual. Tratar incidentes como danificação da carga, falta de peso e contestações de qualidade. 4. Controle de qualidade e origem dos produtos: Colaborar com instituições de inspeção ou terceiros independentes para realizar amostragens, análises laboratoriais e supervisão do carregamento na origem, assegurando que os produtos atendam às normas de importação chinesas e aos controles internos da empresa. Conhecer as diferenças de qualidade entre as principais regiões produtoras do Brasil e planejar racionalmente as áreas de origem dos suprimentos e o ritmo das compras. 5. Coordenação de logística e armazenagem: Interagir com empresas de transporte terrestre interno do Brasil, depósitos portuários, agentes marítimos e despachantes aduaneiros, otimizar os planos de transporte até o porto e transporte marítimo, garantindo o melhor equilíbrio entre prazo logístico e custo. Colaborar com os departamentos nacionais de cadeia de suprimentos, finanças, gestão de riscos e operações comerciais para compartilhar informações, realizar conciliações de contas, efetuar pagamentos e arquivar documentos. 6. Gestão de conformidade e prevenção de riscos: Cumprir as leis trabalhistas, tributárias e comerciais brasileiras, além das normas de quarentena aduaneira e alfândega da China. Identificar e mitigar riscos comerciais, cambiais, de conformidade e de descumprimento contratual. Arquivar todo o conjunto de documentos operacionais para garantir rastreabilidade e auditoria completa. 7. Coordenação inter-regional e elaboração de relatórios: Apresentar regularmente planilhas de controle de compras, análises de custos, relatórios de fornecedores e relatórios semanais/mensais de mercado conforme exigido. Apoiar o planejamento comercial nacional e as demandas da equipe de vendas, garantindo suprimento contínuo e continuidade das operações.

title: Learning support teacher
description:

Job Overview: The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.Core Responsibilities: Student Support & Intervention Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support. Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator. Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies. Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward. Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities. Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills. Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning. Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered. Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans. Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success. Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies. Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans. Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding. Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles. Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required. Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family. Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration. Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator. Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments. Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children. Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs. Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers. Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented). Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.Collaboration Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension. Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports. Monitor students’ progress and well-being. Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners. Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning. Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children. Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning. Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load. Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed. Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.Operational and Professional Conduct Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies. Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress. Maintain accurate student records. Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods. Participate in professional development opportunities. Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned. Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines. Follow theEAC Safeguarding Guide.Other duties, as assigned.Working Conditions: Walk on paths and rough terrain May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set upPOSITION REQUIREMENTS Minimum Education Required: BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent Minimum Experience Required: Five years of teaching experience, preferred Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences. Experience working in a school setting or educational environment. Specific Knowledge: Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners. Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented. Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC’s Teacher Standards. Other Skills (Desirable): Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills. Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven. Collegial and collaborative. Innovative and creative. Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure. English level required: C1 or above Portuguese level required: none for teachers instructing in English C1 or above for teachers instructing in PortugueseChild Safeguarding Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children.We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct.At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Promo writer (brasil)
description:
Empresa está contratando Promo writer (brasil) em porto alegre. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Promo Writer Location: Remote Position Type: Contract Company: Pocket FM About Us At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series. Role Overview As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution. The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance. You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.Key Responsibilities1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series. 2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts. 3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution. 5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further. They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.Role OverviewAs a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.Key Responsibilities1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately80 hours of audio contentwithin defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue deliveryPerform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in EnglishThis role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

title: Senior fpga developer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior fpga developer em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About the Company : Working for a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. A leader in light management technologies for 3 D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications. Employees working on this project are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.About the Role : We are seeking a Principal/Staff-level FPGA Engineer — a recognized technical authority — to own FPGA architecture for our state-of-the-art Communications Test & Measurement products.Responsibilities :The successful candidate will define and drive end-to-end FPGA architecture, including make/buy tradeoffs on IP, floorplanning and timing closure strategy for multi-gigabit designs, and DFX approach, using Verilog/System Verilog/VHDL and industry-leading simulation, synthesis, place-and-route, and formal/UVM verification tools. This person will serve as the final technical escalation point for FPGA design and debug issues across the team, mentor other FPGA engineers, and lead root-cause debug of silicon and board bring-up issues that could not be resolved elsewhere.Qualifications :BS or MS degree in Electrical and/or Computer Engineering with a minimum of 12-15 years of relevant experience, including at least 5+ years specifically architecting and closing timing on multi-Gbps Ser Des/transceiver-based FPGA designs.Required Skills :Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing high-speed FPGA designs using Verilog/System Verilog and/or VHDL required. Deep, hands-on expertise with FPGA transceivers, hard IP, and PLLs — including timing closure, equalization, and link debug at multi-Gbps rates — required (not incidental exposure). Demonstrated experience closing timing and debugging link-layer issues on high-speed Ethernet (10 M to 1.6 T) and IP protocol stacks in production designs. Proven expertise with optical interfaces and modules (SFPs, QSFPs) in shipped products. Deep working knowledge of VLANs, MPLS, VPLS, and Voice/Video over IP (Vo IP, IPTV). Extensive experience with AMD or Altera FPGA devices and their full implementation toolchains, including advanced timing closure and floorplanning techniques. Proven experience with formal verification and/or UVM-based verification methodologies, not limited to directed testbenches. Demonstrated track record of taking FPGA designs from architecture through volume production, including systems-level tradeoffs across the HW/FW boundary. Version control experience using Git or similar tools. Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to mentor engineers and communicate architecture decisions with stakeholders across the world. Exceptional analytical and organizational skills, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and technical rigor in a fast-paced product environment.Preferred Skills : Languages: English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Senior ai agent engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior ai agent engineer em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About First IgniteFirst Ignite makes software for university tech transfer offices. Those are the people who take researchcoming out of a university lab and get it patented, licensed, or spun out into a company.The roleWe're hiring a Senior AI Agent Engineer. You'll build the agents in our product, and you'll build theevals that tell us whether each change made them better or worse.The work is document-heavy rather than chat. The agents run multi-step, call tools, read long andinconsistently formatted source material, check it against existing records, and produce output that aperson reviews before anything happens with it.Accuracy matters more here than speed or novelty. Most of the engineering effort goes into precision,traceability, and getting the agent to hand off to a human at the right moment.You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work with product and the full-stack team. If you'veshipped agents before, you've probably had the experience of changing a prompt and having no ideawhether you improved anything. That problem is most of this job.What you'll do• Design and ship long-running, multi-step, tool-using agents on various AI SDKs and tooling,included but not limited to the Open AI Agents SDK, the Anthropic Agent SDK, the Vercel AI SDK,Lang Graph, MCP, and Temporal Cloud.• Wrap our APIs and our partners' APIs as tools an agent can call over MCP. Some of those systemsare old, single-tenant, and outside our control, so a fair amount of the work is translation.• Get structured data out of long documents and match it against records that already exist. Expectentity resolution and fuzzy matching, and expect much of it to run in batch.• Stand up eval suites using various evaluation frameworks and tooling, included but not limited toPromptfoo, Braintrust, Lang Smith, Deep Eval, LLM-as-judge methods, and custom harnesses.Measure tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and whether the agent finished the task.• Every agent here produces a draft that a person signs off on. Build the citations and confidencesignals that make that review fast, and give the agent a clear way to escalate.• Sit with product and domain experts and turn vague quality goals into something measurable.Sometimes the only dataset available for that is tiny, or confidential, or both.• Instrument production traffic, turn real customer interactions into golden datasets, and run them asregression tests.• Compare models against each other (Open AI, Anthropic, open-weight), along with promptstrategies and agent designs, and know what each option costs in latency and quality.• Bootstrap quality signal for features that have no production traffic yet. That usually meansgenerating synthetic documents and test cases, including the ugly edge cases real customers willeventually send us, and knowing where synthetic data stops being a good proxy.• Write the templates, docs, and tooling the rest of the team needs to run evals without coming toyou.Required Qualifications:• 3+ years of engineering experience, including hands-on work on LLM or agent systems that realusers touched.• You've evaluated agents, not only models, and you know why single-turn accuracy says little abouta multi-step run.• You've integrated against APIs you don't own, including old ones with bad documentation, andturned them into something an agent can call reliably.• You're comfortable with document pipelines: pulling data out, normalizing it, and checking it againsta structured source of truth.• You've used at least one LLM evaluation framework, in-house tooling included.• You know how LLM-as-judge methods break down (position bias, verbosity bias, judge drift) andwhat to do about it.• You can tell a real regression from noise, and design an experiment that answers the questionbeing asked instead of a nearby one.• You can read a customer call transcript, work out which failures matter, and ship a fix and an evalfor them.• You write clearly. Engineers won't act on eval results they don't read or don't trust.• You're based somewhere between New York time (ET) and Western European time. Italy is thefurthest east we can go.You might currently be titledAI Agent Engineer · Agentic AI Engineer · Senior AI Engineer · AI Systems Engineer · Lead AIDeveloper · AI Solutions Architect · AI Integration Specialist · Senior Data Scientist, AITitles are all over the place in this space. If the work above matches what you already do, apply. We'llgo on what you've shipped.Preferred Qualifications:• You've evaluated retrieval systems: RAG, hybrid search, reranking.• You've worked with agent orchestration frameworks like Temporal, Lang Graph, or the Open AIAgents SDK, and you know how long-running tool use goes wrong.• You have a background in information retrieval or search relevance.• You've worked somewhere an agent's output carried financial or compliance consequences.• You've built internal tooling that non-engineers used on their own to label and review model output.

title: Qc analyst - audio content - brazil
description:

About UsPocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.Role OverviewAs a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.Key Responsibilities1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately80 hours of audio contentwithin defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue deliveryPerform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in EnglishThis role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

title: Promo writer (brasil)
description:
Empresa está contratando Promo writer (brasil) em curitiba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Promo Writer Location: Remote Position Type: Contract Company: Pocket FM About Us At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series. Role Overview As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution. The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance. You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.Key Responsibilities1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series. 2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts. 3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution. 5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further. They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble4. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology9. title: Pesquisador doutor - vidya - orquestração e otimização multi-cloud - doutores inovando no setor empr

A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo. O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas. Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.Sobre a Oportunidade:A Vidya é uma empresa de tecnologia aplicada à engenharia industrial, com atuação no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais para apoiar operações complexas, gestão de ativos e tomada de decisão em ambientes industriais. Em um cenário de expansão tecnológica, a empresa busca fortalecer sua infraestrutura digital com soluções mais inteligentes, seguras, escaláveis e preparadas para ambientes multi-cloud. Se você tem interesse em atuar com arquitetura Cloud, Dev Ops, Sec Ops, Agentic AI, AIOps e automação inteligente em ambientes tecnológicos complexos, essa oportunidade é para você. Buscamos um perfil técnico, analítico e inovador, com visão prática para desenvolver soluções escaláveis, seguras e de alto impacto para plataformas industriais.Formação Acadêmica: Doutorado completo emCiência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Engenharia de Computação ou áreas correlatas. Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos. Idioma:Inglês para leituraProjeto:Orquestração e Otimização Multi-Cloud com Dev Ops Autônomo e Inteligência Artificial.Principais Atividades: Mapeamento e diagnóstico da infraestrutura multi-cloud (AWS, GCP, OCI) com foco em custos, vulnerabilidades e conformidade de acessos (IAM); Implementação de framework de Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C) modularizado e gerenciado por agentes de IA; Construção de pipelines CI/CD multi-cloud com deploy Blue/Green e integração de agentes de IA na esteira; Codificação de políticas de segurança e conformidade via Policy-as-Code e integração de ferramentas Dev Sec Ops; Treinamento de modelos de Machine Learning para detecção de ameaças e escalonamento preditivo (Fin Ops); Implantação de agentes autônomos de Auto-healing, AIOps e dashboard inteligente de segurança e custos; Transferência de tecnologia, documentação da plataforma e elaboração do relatório técnico final.Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos Arquitetura e operação em ambientes multi-cloud (AWS, GCP e/ou OCI); Infraestrutura como Código — Ia C (Terraform ou equivalente); Pipelines de CI/CD (Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI, Argo CD ou similares); Conteinerização e orquestração (Docker e Kubernetes); Segurança em nuvem: IAM, gestão de vulnerabilidades e conformidade; Machine Learning aplicado: treinamento, validação e implantação de modelos.Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais Agentic AI / LLM Ops — agentes de IA para automação de workflows; AIOps — detecção de anomalias e monitoramento inteligente; Fin Ops — otimização de custos em nuvem e Predictive Autoscaling; Policy-as-Code (Open Policy Agent, Sentinel ou similares); Arquiteturas de auto-healing e failover automatizado multi-cloud; Publicações acadêmicas em Dev Sec Ops, MLOps ou infraestrutura autônoma.Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor EmpresarialFormato de trabalho : Remoto / Curitiba/PRSoft Skills : Autogestão, Autonomia, Organização, Trabalho em equipe e Criatividade.

A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo. O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas. Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável. Sobre a Oportunidade: A oportunidade está inserida no setor automotivo, um dos segmentos industriais mais estratégicos, tecnológicos e competitivos do mercado global. Trata-se de um ambiente altamente dinâmico, orientado à eficiência operacional, à transformação digital e à adoção de soluções inovadoras para fortalecer a produtividade, a qualidade e a maturidade tecnológica dos processos de manufatura. O projeto tem como objetivo desenvolver e implementar um ecossistema inteligente de monitoramento e controle de máquinas industriais, utilizando dados históricos, estatística avançada, Inteligência Artificial, Io T e interfaces homem-máquina com foco em UX. A iniciativa busca apoiar a otimização de parâmetros produtivos, a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e a evolução das práticas de Indústria 4.0 no ambiente fabril. Se você deseja aplicar pesquisa avançada em um desafio real da indústria, conectando Inteligência Artificial, manufatura, UX, otimização de processos e tecnologias digitais, este projeto oferece um ambiente estratégico para gerar impacto direto na operação industrial e contribuir com soluções inovadoras para o futuro da produção automotiva. Formação Acadêmica: Doutorado completo em Engenharia de Controle e Automação, Engenharia Mecatrônica, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas correlatas à automação e processos industriais. Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos. Idioma: Inglês avançado. Projeto: Interface homem-máquina e otimização de parâmetros de processos industriais - Inteligência Artificial e UX Aplicadas à Otimização de Parâmetros de Manufatura na Indústria Principais Atividades: Mapear processos industriais, parâmetros de máquina, fluxos de operação e pontos críticos de controle, identificando oportunidades de otimização, padronização e automação. Desenvolver e validar soluções de interface homem-máquina, com foco em usabilidade, experiência do usuário, parametrização eficiente e apoio à tomada de decisão no chão de fábrica. Apoiar a integração entre máquinas, sensores, sistemas industriais, plataformas digitais e ferramentas de monitoramento, contribuindo para um ecossistema inteligente de controle de processos. Propor metodologias para otimização de parâmetros industriais, considerando qualidade, produtividade, estabilidade de processo, segurança operacional e redução de variabilidade. Elaborar documentação técnica, fluxos operacionais, critérios de validação, treinamentos e materiais de apoio para implantação das soluções junto às equipes industriais. Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos: Conhecimento em análise de dados industriais, controle estatístico de processo ou indicadores de performance produtiva. Experiência com sistemas supervisórios, MES, SCADA, CLP, redes industriais ou plataformas digitais de manufatura. Vivência em projetos de transformação digital, manufatura avançada, melhoria contínua ou automação em ambiente automotivo. Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial Formato de trabalho : Híbrido – Quatro Barras/PR – 3x por semana presencial – disponibilidade para viagem. Soft Skills : Liderança, Autogestão, Autonomia.

title: Parceiro de negócios
description:
Nova oportunidade para Parceiro de negócios em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Parceiro(a) de Negócios | Agro Busca®Sobre a oportunidadeNo agro, a gente sabe que bons negócios começam com uma boa conversa, confiança e vontade de construir junto.A Agro Busca está recebendo solicitações de clientes de várias regiões do Brasil e está formando um time de parceiros apaixonados pelo agronegócio, por tecnologia e por ajudar pessoas.
